notes.title: Development progress and scheduled update
notes.content:
Hello all,

This announcement is to inform you of the state of the game and what we have been working on since the launch also when the scheduled update will occur.


First of all....

We would like to apologize for not updating this game as frequently as we have planned to. There are several reasons for that and we do not want to beat around the bush.  We want to be honest with you, hopefully this will give you a better view of what's happening behind the scenes in game development.

Much to our dismay, after the launch only a few core members stayed true to the team and SCORE and it's vision.  We knew Score would need a lot of development  it was never a "done' in a month" project. Others did not share these values and moved on to other projects.  We wish them all the best success now and in the future.

As it stands we have been left with a very very small team. The small amount of sales has allowed us to keep the server running. The team has continued to be and remains active even though the current development is very slow.  To those of you who have been with us from the start providing your amazing encouragement and positivity we appreciate you and we will not let you down!  We want to see this game reach it's full potential, allowing us to deliver the vision you and we believe in.

On the other hand to have this game reach it's full potential we still require your feedback and suggestions.  It is very important for us to receive participation and feedback from the communtiy.   

We have implemented changes including the overhaul of the Soccer game mechanic it was done completely new and from scratch, we still plan to expand heavily on it .  This includes the AI and game modes, until all features are implemented. 

For the Professions and the City we listened to all your feedback and we decided because of the scope and irritations it has caused we will remove professions from this game until its implemented right.
For the City environment we are in the process of redoing the entire city and the island as well. 
We are working on a complete new Pedestrian and Traffic AI to make it come alive and behave naturally. So it's a complete overhaul.
Because being a Soccer Player  will be your only profession you will start earning money for every goal scored, every assists you made every win you took home.
With this earned money you will be able to buy clothes in shops, buy cars at the car dealership (already working), buy furniture and appartments or houses that will be available to purchase all around the city.
Mini games in the city will also be added   The club mode in soccer is still in development.You will be able to create your own club and trade players or aquire real human players for your club, with that you will have the challenge to earn enough money for your club to keep those players season after season.


The last part of this announcement is explaining how we want to get there.

First of all we all know that game development is not cheap or easy 
and to be able to  create our and your vision for this game 
we needed to make some choices.

We decided to support and work on two other games to help us fund this 
game and quite frankly to partner up with some great talent.  Studios have 
approached us to support them with their games, by active development or 
just helping them with publishing it. Which we did and we will tell you more 
about those exciting games, when the time is right.

With this announcement  which is long overdue  we want to explain what's 
behind the scenes and why games don't  push updates after updates weekly.
We do not want to push half done broken updates. But we do want to assure 
you that this game will get the development it deserves, it's the core teams 
dream game that we want to play and love! Therefore we will never ever stop
working on it.  We have planned great features for it but they have to make 
sense not to confuse players of the reason for this game. 
We came far without any kickstarter, outside funding.  

Again we are reaching out to everyone who likes the idea of this game to 
support us and shape it into the game we want to create, and a game we love 
to play as it is our first game on steam. 

A major update is expected to be early 2018.

Thank you!

True Illusion Software Development Team

notes.title: New Football Update is finally live !!!!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are pleased to announce that our build up from scratch Football update is finally up on Steam.

[h1]WHAT'S NEW?[/h1]

1.) New Player characters and animations 
2.) New Stadium 
3.) Included Control Mapper with support for Gamepad and Keyboard Controls.
4.) Better AI logic and interaction 
5.) Now it's possible to play alone vs AI  or up to 10vs10 
6.) New and better formation visuals , now you can see who is playing a 
     certain position.
7.) Halftime and Fulltime Stats are enabled 
8.) On the fly Camera view can change by pressing C 
9.) Penalty, Freekick and Stamina implemented.


Default Keyboard Controls are  WSAD for movement ,  K - Kick , L - Pass , P-Special Movements and LShift Running (depends on Stamina)  but you can set it up your way  or use Gamepad controller(needs to be assigned first time , press on the Gamepad Icon) 


[h1]UPDATE: 18/12/2016[/h1]
---------------
We have implemented the following with a small update today:
- Headers for AI or Players depending on Ball velocity.
- Two dribble animations with Action Key  and Action Key and Control UP
- Goal Celebration animations
- Referee  is showing now red and yellow cards.
- Increased overall running and sprinting speed
- Apartment spinning bug when Gamepad is plugged in should be fixed now.
- AI will try to pass to teammate if either teammate or opponent player is close. 
-More updates and fixes to come


[h1]NEXT BIG UPDATE[/h1] 
we are working on is the CITY environment.
We decided to reduce the size of the city a lot for now to improve the performance. The Island terrain is still 256km2 




Stay Tuned,

your  True Illusion Software Developer Team

notes.title: Football Gameplay Update 12th of December 2016
notes.content:
Hello all,
we are very pleased to announce that we have redone the Football Gameplay, from scratch.

Update we are in the final process for the update to steam ( build+upload)!!!
We are experiencing some build issues and therefore have to postphone it
for the 12th or 13st of December 2016. 



[b][h1] Next Updates for the Football Mode in early 2017 are [/h1][/b]
- Club mode will be activated, meaning you will be able to play with your  
   friends and AI against other clubs of the same division for money and 
   experience points that will be reflected in your stats.
- Club House where you can socialize with club members and other visitors, 
   train your player in a gym or play some fun games like billiard with others.
- Custom Match Offline mode for up to 8 players on the same PC, will allow 
   you to play 4vs4 matches with your friends at home.

[b][h1] Next revamp will be the City Environment and Gameplay [/h1][/b]
- Entire Island and City will be redone from scratch with the focus on 
   performance and loading times.
- City Pedestrians AI will allow interaction and specific gameplay.
- City Traffic system will be activated ( we have this one done a long time 
   ago but because of overall performance issues it was deactivated)
- Profession Missions will be clearly visible and will
   have a progression logic story line. 
- Enabling the purchase of all 50+ Cars( right now only 11 can be bought)
- Enabling the purchase of furniture for your apartments
- Enabling the purchase of different apartments and houses in the city.
- Enabling the character selection and customization 
   of 5 Female and 5 Male Characters. 
- Enabling Steams Workshop for submissions of clothes and other city 
   environment props through the community. 

[b][h1] Single Player Mission Mode Road to Glory [/h1][/b]
-  We are also working on the single player mission mode 
   that will tie the football  and city game mode together 
   and explain how all makes sense, why a football star to be has to take on    
   jobs on the side to get where he wants to 
   be in his career. Our game is inspired by the Movie Goal (part1 and part2) 
   go and watch it, it will explain a lot what's going on
   behind the scenes of a Soccer Player's life. 

  Please stay tuned with the upcoming announcements on specific updates.

 Thanks

 Lisa

notes.title: SCORE Performance UPDATE released
notes.content:
Hi all,
we just released  a major update to our game SCORE and would like to to keep you updated with  our changelog announcements as they happen.

-We reduced the texture size in almost every part of the city to improve loading time and performance.
-We  remodeled all the trees in the city to have a LOD system now, which is increasing performance , we still have a bug with billboards and clouds clipping which we are working on to fix (visual bug)
-Fixed Assassin clothing issue
-Improved terrain in some areas of the island
-Fixed Male character selection freeze, we still have the freeze when going back from female to male, so for now either choose male and hit save or female But going back and for will freeze the character selection.


CHANGES TO THE FOOTBALL CUSTOM MATCHES
-Added go to Club Lobby button to Apartment Menu 
-Camera view has changed to be behind the player and closer to the pitch
-Stadium field textures improvements 
-Improved visual look of all Football jerseys on the field
-Football match controls are still being completely redone right now its focused on the camera view and not on the player direction.
 We should have a update in 2-3 days with completely redone controls.

NEW CONTENT and PLAY MODES 
- Police character has been enabled , we are still fixing his uniform it doesn't wrap right around male characters. Female Police is fine.
- Assassin male clothes changed and improved visually
- New King of the Hill style Mini Game  (look for the Stars on the Minimap)
  Those capture points give out Money every couple of seconds to who ever
  is close to it, but the money output decreases if other players are close by,
  so make sure you get rid off your competition by killing them to maximize 
  the output of money for your pockets :) 
- Everyone is getting a start vehicle in there garage now.
We will have updates come in as we fix bugs or enable more content, so it could be that you see two updates in  a day or that some take a bit longer. It could be also being the state of the game that we fix bugs and by mistake create new once, therefore we do need your feedback and will do our best to fix issues in a timely but controlled manner. 

As I write this we are already building a new fix for the Police uniform and a  fix for not being able to go into your car at all times.
So we will push this out asap.
Another side note,  we are a self funded  indie developer group that works on this project for quite some time because we are gamers like you and with no outside funding like kickstarter etc.  
have come so far in the development of this game. Our promise to you is we are not out to make a quick buck and disappear but to make this game the best it could be and the only logical step for us was to bring it to Early Access to have you the community help us in shapeing this game, we create this game for you and with you and you have a say in every step of the development. 

With being on Early Access we as developers can interact and react better with you and change things quicker, then going the kickstarter way where you have no say don't know what's being done with what you have backed and when its being done , and this is one  more reason we went on Early Access because we like you to have a say on every aspect of development and not show you still images of what we try to sell you and then release a game that cannot change when released, if it was backed on kick starter. 
We love, love your feedback your comments and all the interaction with you it has been a great and fantastic experience so far and only because of you the fans of  SCORE a great Steam community. We are deeply thankful for that.

Thanks Lisa

notes.content:
Hi all,
we just released  a major update to our game SCORE and would like to to keep you updated with  our changelog announcements as they happen.

-We reduced the texture size in almost every part of the city to improve loading time and performance.
-We  remodeled all the trees in the city to have a LOD system now, which is increasing performance , we still have a bug with billboards and clouds clipping which we are working on to fix (visual bug)
-Fixed Assassin clothing issue
-Improved terrain in some areas of the island
-Fixed Male character selection freeze, we still have the freeze when going back from female to male, so for now either choose male and hit save or female But going back and for will freeze the character selection.


CHANGES TO THE FOOTBALL CUSTOM MATCHES
-Added go to Club Lobby button to Apartment Menu 
-Camera view has changed to be behind the player and closer to the pitch
-Stadium field textures improvements 
-Improved visual look of all Football jerseys on the field
-Football match controls are still being completely redone right now its focused on the camera view and not on the player direction.
 We should have a update in 2-3 days with completely redone controls.

NEW CONTENT and PLAY MODES 
- Police character has been enabled , we are still fixing his uniform it doesn't wrap right around male characters. Female Police is fine.
- Assassin male clothes changed and improved visually
- New King of the Hill style Mini Game  (look for the Stars on the Minimap)
  Those capture points give out Money every couple of seconds to who ever
  is close to it, but the money output decreases if other players are close by,
  so make sure you get rid off your competition by killing them to maximize 
  the output of money for your pockets :) 
- Everyone is getting a start vehicle in there garage now.
We will have updates come in as we fix bugs or enable more content, so it could be that you see two updates in  a day or that some take a bit longer. It could be also being the state of the game that we fix bugs and by mistake create new once, therefore we do need your feedback and will do our best to fix issues in a timely but controlled manner. 

As I write this we are already building a new fix for the Police uniform and a  fix for not being able to go into your car at all times.
So we will push this out asap.
Another side note,  we are a self funded  indie developer group that works on this project for quite some time because we are gamers like you and with no outside funding like kickstarter etc.  
have come so far in the development of this game. Our promise to you is we are not out to make a quick buck and disappear but to make this game the best it could be and the only logical step for us was to bring it to Early Access to have you the community help us in shapeing this game, we create this game for you and with you and you have a say in every step of the development. 

With being on Early Access we as developers can interact and react better with you and change things quicker, then going the kickstarter way where you have no say don't know what's being done with what you have backed and when its being done , and this is one  more reason we went on Early Access because we like you to have a say on every aspect of development and not show you still images of what we try to sell you and then release a game that cannot change when released, if it was backed on kick starter. 
We love, love your feedback your comments and all the interaction with you it has been a great and fantastic experience so far and only because of you the fans of  SCORE a great Steam community. We are deeply thankful for that.

Thanks Lisa
